credits.title: Credits
credits.disclaimer.title: Original content notice
credits.disclaimer.more: Metin Survivors is an independent, original roguelite game. Every piece of art, 3D model, icon, typeface, sound effect, music track, and line of code shipped here is original or properly licensed under open-source terms.
credits.who.art: Original paintings made with an image model, art-directed by the team
credits.who.models: Original models from our procedural and image-to-3D pipelines
credits.who.audio: Original music and sound effects, synthesized with our own audio tools
credits.who.writing: Original lore, codex and Turkish / English text
credits.fonts.license: Licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
credits.thanks.playersText: Every bug report and every high score made this game better.
credits.thanks.communityText: For the memories that inspired this homage — a reference only.
credits.outro: Thank you for playing. May your stones always fall in your favour.
